about: Reviewed places where two active Octatrack modules meet on the same stock bytes; read by scripts/module-compat.py (npm run modules:compat, part of npm run check). Any overlap not listed here fails, and so does an entry naming a module that is no longer active or a site where nothing meets any more. group-owned: one module's reviewed composition owns every listed site. pending-migration: allowed only until both modules subscribe to the named event. New entries need owner review; for shared behaviour, request an event instead (docs/module-guides/README.md#propose-an-event).

relations.reason: Machine-group seams owned by POLY8's composition (sdk/octabam/modules/poly8/composition.json, applied by sdk/octabam/tools/remix/machine_composition.py; dispatch order POLY8, VECTOR, FM, QZ, AB). Analog BD's chooser, SETUP editor/drawer and renderer seams; POLY8's displaced-instruction replays copy the same sites from the user's own OS file.

Machine-group seams owned by POLY8's composition (sdk/octabam/modules/poly8/composition.json, applied by sdk/octabam/tools/remix/machine_composition.py; dispatch order POLY8, VECTOR, FM, QZ, AB). Without POLY8 the configurator refuses this pair (src/catalog/selection-conflicts.ts). Both add a machine row at the same chooser, page and renderer seams.

Without POLY8 the configurator refuses this pair (src/catalog/selection-conflicts.ts). Both add a machine row at the same chooser, page, renderer and Part-validation seams; VECTOR's replays copy the same sites from the user's own OS file.

Scale Quantizer's octave key and number seams are POLY8's keyboard hooks: POLY8's MR_NEXT chain calls Quantizer's handlers for every non-POLY track (quantizer/composition.json).

VECTOR's chooser, sample-pool navigation and renderer seams; both modules' replays copy the same sites from the user's own OS file.

Without POLY8 the configurator refuses this pair (src/catalog/selection-conflicts.ts). FM Synth bundles a private Scale Quantizer (the same hooks, two pinned caves and the three SEQUENCER table roots); with POLY8 the composition keeps FM's quantizer as the one SEQUENCER table owner and drops the public Quantizer's claims.

relations.until: Repitch and POLY8 subscribe to ev_play_increment once the USB loader supports subscribe; then both raw detours go and this entry is removed.
relations.reason: Both scale the shared CPU/DSP playback increment at 0x40004100. Today POLY8's composition owns the site: its mr_rate_hook (poly8/shared-machine-hooks.s, MR_NEXT) takes POLY tracks and chains Repitch's rate_hook for every other track, so the reviewed order is POLY8, then Repitch.

relations.until: Mute Modes and POLY8 subscribe to ev_voice_bind once the USB loader supports subscribe; then both raw detours go and this entry is removed.
relations.reason: Both act when a fresh voice is bound at 0x40006820. POLY8's mr_stop_voice stops the selected POLY extension, then chains Mute Modes' fresh_bind (poly8/polyphony.s) unless POLY8 is rendering, so the reviewed order is POLY8, then Mute Modes.
